failure_rule: sampling started without durable COMPLETE => CONSUMED_INVALID => M3-S2S-X for the affected arm => STOP, NO REPLAY, NO SAME-ARM RERUN
pre_simulator_failure: incident + engineering fix + re-preflight + re-hash (+ re-authorization if hash-locked artifacts changed)
sidecar_rule: instrumentation sidecar written + sha256-verified BEFORE ledger COMPLETE; sidecar failure => no COMPLETE
